added_entries.title_zh: 身体、生态参与与认知选择
added_entries.title_en: Embodied organization, ecological participation and cognitive choice
added_entries.claim_zh: 细胞、器官与身体通过实际组织和支持相连；认知在其中形成分辨、保持和选择，活动又改变身体及生态条件。生态参与不等同于固定解剖层级。
added_entries.claim_en: Cells, organs and bodies are related through actual organization and support; cognition discriminates, retains and selects within these relations, and activity changes bodily and ecological conditions. Ecological participation differs from a fixed anatomical hierarchy.
added_entries.scope_zh: 解释性整合；四项原始研究支持分别的机制连接，另有14项新 Lean 定理；不冒称单一完整生物轨迹、意识理论或普遍伦理证明
added_entries.scope_en: Explanatory integration; four primary studies constrain separate mechanisms, with 14 additional Lean theorems; no single complete biological trajectory, theory of consciousness or universal ethical proof

added_entries.title_zh: 选择影响尺度误差的形式检查
added_entries.title_en: Formal checks of action-sensitive scale errors
added_entries.claim_zh: 所选行动影响之差进入有限时域误差界；阈值余量足以保持指定选择，近阈值反例及共享支持被他者消耗后的计划失败均经过实查。
added_entries.claim_en: Differences in selected action effects enter the finite-horizon error bound; threshold margins suffice to preserve specified choices, with checked near-threshold counterexamples and failed retained plans after another participant consumes shared support.
added_entries.scope_zh: 14项新定理／63项继承审计，使用标准逻辑；策略、对应和活动规则明示，有限见证无生理拟合或生态更新
added_entries.scope_en: 14 new theorems / 63 inherited audits, with standard logic; policies, correspondence and activity laws explicit; finite witness has no physiological fit or ecological renewal
